data.plainLyric:

Whether it's tonight or 55 years down the road
Oh, I know there's so many ways that this could go
Don't want you to wonder, darling, I need you to know

We were talking to the sunset

Oh, I know there's so many ways that this could go

Oh-oh, oh, oh, oh
Oh, oh, oh
